title: A New Phone
text:
Maria bought a new phone last week. She read many online reviews before she made her choice. Most reviews said the battery was very good, but some people did not like the small screen. Maria thought the reviews were helpful.

After one month, she wrote her own review. She gave the phone four stars. She said the camera was great, but the phone was a little heavy. Her review helped other people decide to buy it too.

questions.text: What did Maria buy last week?
How many stars did Maria give the phone?
Why did Maria read reviews before she bought the phone?
options: She wanted to get useful information
She wanted to sell her old phone
She did not have time to shop

questions.text: What can we infer about Maria's review?
options: It may help other people choose a phone
It was written before she bought the phone
It was about a different product

vocabulary.definition: comments that people write about a product
useful or good for a purpose

paragraph_translations: María compró un teléfono nuevo la semana pasada. Antes de tomar una decisión, leyó muchas opiniones en internet. La mayoría de las opiniones decían que la batería era muy buena, pero algunas personas no les gustaba la pantalla pequeña. María pensaba que las opiniones eran útiles.

Después de un mes, escribió su propia opinión. Le dio cuatro estrellas al teléfono. Dijo que la cámara era genial, pero que el teléfono era un poco pesado. Su opinión ayudó a otras personas a decidir comprarlo también.
